contribution.position: My reliability position is unchanged: evidence still does not clear the bar. The fan-out worker has two sev2 incidents last quarter traced to retry storms (artifact:incident-log), the change touches that exact failure path, and artifact:ops-runbook confirms no chaos experiment has ever been run against the worker. Ops cites an artifact (chaos-fanout-run-7) that does not exist in the available evidence set, and it directly contradicts artifact:ops-runbook — that claim cannot be credited. Passing tests (artifact:test-report, 412 passed, 87% coverage) and in-budget p99 (artifact:perf-report) are necessary but do not exercise the retry-storm failure mode that actually hurt us. Reliability confidence requires a chaos/fault-injection experiment targeting retry behavior under downstream degradation, plus evidence the change does not amplify retry fan-out.
